profile.commute: Blue Line to Damen, then a twenty minute walk
profile.hobby: open water swimming at Ohio Street Beach

memories.text: Came off a night shift and swam one point two miles at Ohio Street Beach before the lake filled up with the seven o'clock triathlon club.
Miso has chewed through three phone charger cords since June and I have started running them behind the radiator where she cannot reach.
Decided to relabel every drawer on the crash cart with colour tape, green for airway and orange for lines, because two of us kept opening the wrong one.
My brother Teo called from his garage to say he had finally got the flippers working on the 1979 pinball machine he has been rebuilding for a year.
The Blue Line was single tracking at Division so I got off at Damen and walked the last twenty minutes in the rain without a hood.
I keep roasted barley tea in a dented green thermos that has a sticker of a whale on the base, and it holds heat for about nine hours.
Spent my afternoon off at the Ravenswood farmers market and came home with a pound of sour cherries and a chipped enamel jug for four dollars.
Decided to take the Tuesday and Thursday nights off the rotation in September so I can actually go to my nephew's soccer games.
Told the two new grads that the infusion pump on bed four beeps a half second early and that they should trust the number on the screen, not the sound.
My car, a 2011 Honda Fit I call Pickle, needed a jump in the hospital garage and a security guard named Ernesto did it with a battery pack from his cart.
My nephew Oscar turns seven on the twenty-ninth and has asked for a telescope, a bearded dragon, and a trip to the aquarium, in that order.
Swapped shifts with Danielle so she could go to her sister's wedding in Milwaukee, which means I work eleven of the next fourteen nights.
Decided to switch the unit handover from a whiteboard to a printed one page sheet, because the whiteboard kept getting wiped by the cleaning crew at five.
The unit manager asked me to run the orientation week for the new cohort of eight nurses starting the first Monday of September, and I said yes before thinking.
Started my night shift at half eleven and found somebody had finally fixed the flickering light over the second sink after four months of complaints.
Walked out into fog so thick I could not see the top of the parking structure, and Miso was sitting on the windowsill waiting when I got in.
I sleep with blackout curtains and a fan set to the middle speed, and I have learned to fall asleep by ten past nine in the morning.
Texted Teo that I would drive up on Sunday to help him carry the pinball backglass, on the condition that he feeds me his terrible chili.
